title: Izzy Small Nubuck Barrel Pochette
description_html:
Izzy Small Nubuck Barrel Pochette by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 9.25”W X 3.75”H X 3.75”D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance.
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
